english.note: Use this when the action is driven specifically by an innate instinct or reflex, rather than by a considered intuition.

examples.english: When the ball came flying at me, I intuitively reached out and caught it.
examples.traditional: 見到個波飛埋嚟，我靠本能伸手接住。
